cells: Fuchs Conjectures 2.3 and 2.4 / AMR-049-0002+0003 (5000002+5000003): vertex types of reachable polygons; existence and infinitude through reachable points

On Seven Conjectures of Fuchs on Billiard Trajectories in Regular Polygons and Geodesics on the Regular Dodecahedron — Alper Ferudun (Mercury Software GmbH), version1.0,9October2026. Existing external publication; not Alec Kriebel authorship or a new publication from this sweep. Coverage here is TheoremsD/F only: for every n>=5, fixed-origin linear SL(2,R) images in the original normalized sector have clockwise vertex types A0,A1,...,A(n-3),A0 whenever reachable; four specified reachable vertices suffice. Universal Conjecture2.4 is false even without infinitude: exactly A0 points lie on infinitely many reachable polygons, every other type lies on at most one, and w_n=2+3zeta+zeta^2, zeta=exp(2pi i/n), lies on none. Types retain Fuchs segment parity and Fig9 diagonal labels; his isolated unconditional A0 difference-angle shortcut is false. Fuchs original n6 proof of2.3 remains credited; the n6 point(5,4) independently refutes bare existence using his lattice formulas alone. No translated-polygon or n3/n4 extension, other-five-conjecture/TheoremE certification, independent discovery or exhaustive first-priority claim. Paper PDF, full320-member/306-regular-file source and reproduction ZIP, and identical standalone/archived verification report checked against current Zenodo size/MD5/SHA256; exact algebra and n6 controls independently reproduced. The universal conclusions rest on the written geometric proof, not finite enumeration. Extensive AI involvement; unrefereed preprint, no conventional independent human peer review or formal proof certification.
